decision.reason: [ev-f21609ff075e] is just a one-line bug-fix title, "scheduling zone-id flake", with a pointer to PR #6493. It doesn't name the component or field involved. It gives no before/after behaviour and no environment conditions, and it doesn't say what operators would see. It also doesn't say whether the fix changes product scheduling code or only fixes a flaky test. The PR description or diff would be needed to write any of the four aspects.
